QuestInfo.name: Keol's Order #12
QuestInfo.0: Keol, the pompous working partner of Moren who is as irritable as they come in all of Maple, is giving me a new work request. Better go see what it is.
QuestInfo.1: Moren's coworker Keol received a special request from Muse to make a pair of boots for Nanuke, who spends his days alone with the dogs at the Snowy Whale's Island, and asked if I could make one for him. That's really nice of Muse to do that.\n\n#i4001185# #t4001185# #b#c4001185# / 1
QuestInfo.2: I made a pair of fur boots for Nanuke on behalf of Muse. Whale Island is a cold, cold place to live in, so I made sure to pack in enough fur to make it as warm as possible.

0.0: This is a very detailed, difficult request. It has to be warm, light, and pretty at the same time... It's a request from Muse of Aquarium. The recipient is Nanuke from the Whale Island. This is the only order we received today, so... do you want to take care of this?

yes.0: It's not much, and making the boots itself shouldn't take too much work... it's the list of demands she made that will be hard to cover. This is the kind of order we all would like to avoid, so for you to take this offer without hesitation is quite surprising. Now it's up to you to make #b1 #t4001185##k, catering to all those demands. Hopefully this won't come out too terribly...

no.0: If you want to tackle something else, then you can just sit around and wait.

1.0: Not bad. It's not the best in the world, but I'll take it. As for your fee, choose the reward for yourself. We received a huge batch of Magic Powder yesterday, so we have plenty around here right now.

item.0: You're doing okay with #b#t4001185##k? I hope it doesn't come out with disasterous results. It's never a good feeling to recall an item because of a defect.

lost.0: This is preposterous. Unbelievable. How can you not even take care of the purchase order I gave you? What was Moren thinking? Seriously, un-be-lieeevable.
